_readme: Renso: this file (src/data/portfolio.json) is the one place to edit the facts on the site. It feeds the certificate cards, flip-card backs, certificate pop-up, education details, hero stats, internship snapshot, contact links and the printable resume. Any empty string or empty list renders NOTHING on the page, so only fill a slot with something true. resume.pdf = path of a 1-page PDF you add to the repo (for example assets/Casalme_Renso_Resume.pdf); while it is empty the hero button prints the built-in resume instead. ojt.hours = required OJT hours (e.g. '486 hours'); ojt.window = when you can start and end; ojt.setup = Onsite / Hybrid / Remote; ojt.commute = cities you can reach; ojt.moa = e.g. 'DLSL endorsement letter available'. certs[].verifyUrl = the Credly / NetAcad link that proves the certificate (the Cisco images show a Cert ID at the bottom); a 'Verify credential' button appears once it is set. about.story = one or two sentences in your own words about what pulled you into IT. education[].details = short bullet facts; elementary and secondary stay empty until you confirm them. The hero '72+ Modules Completed' stat is plain HTML: change it if the 58-module Accenture certificate already includes the 14. analytics.goatcounter = your GoatCounter site code, if you decide to use it. Keep valid JSON: double quotes, no trailing commas.
